PRJEB47976.name: AlzBiom Cross-Sectional
PRJEB47976.reconciliation: Published paper reports 175 participants (75 amyloid-positive AD, 100 controls); 192 deposited runs include replicates/controls. Raw FASTQ files are not stored locally. Published study taxonomic-model AUROC: 0.76 (train), 0.61 (val).

PRJEB72198.name: AlzBiom Longitudinal MCI Progression
PRJEB72198.reconciliation: Published paper reports 49 MCI participants followed ~4 years (27 converters, 22 stable MCI). Raw FASTQs not stored locally. Published study AUROCs: taxonomic 0.87 (baseline), 0.92 (1-yr), 0.95 (4-yr); ensemble 0.96 (baseline), 0.96 (1-yr), 0.97 (4-yr).

PRJEB85717.name: AlzBiom Preclinical Aging
PRJEB85717.reconciliation: Published study reports 100 enrolled: 57 stable, 29 converted to MCI, 14 dropouts. Raw FASTQs not stored locally.

PRJNA679346.name: Japanese NCGG Outpatient Cohort
PRJNA679346.reconciliation: Saji et al. clinical publication evaluated 128 outpatients with Fazekas white matter hyperintensity scores; public BioProject PRJNA679346 contains only 43 SRA BioSamples (Ueda et al. sequencing subset). OASIS-3.name: OASIS-3 Longitudinal Multimodal Neuroimaging
OASIS-3.historical_version_reconciled: 2019 medRxiv pre-print (LaMontagne et al., 2019) reported 1,098 participants, ~2,155 MRI sessions, ~1,000 PET sessions.
OASIS-3.reconciliation: Current official OASIS-3 inventory reports 1,378 participants, 2,842 MRI sessions, and 2,157 PET sessions. No authorized crosswalk to ADAM-1; real-world participant overlap remains unresolved; cross-study record merging is strictly prohibited.

GARD.name: Gwangju Alzheimer's & Related Dementias Cohort
GARD.reconciliation: Cohort documents 12,877 enrolled participants, 10,843 MRI scans, and 595 gut microbiome samples. The count of participants with paired microbiome and neuroimaging data is UNKNOWN_NOT_VERIFIED and must never be derived from modality totals. Crosswalk status: 'No public crosswalk found; direct confirmation pending formal request submission'. Request state is strictly REQUEST_NOT_SENT.
